name: GDSY Open 2017

venue.name: Guangdong Experimental High School
venue.address: No.1 Shengshi Road, Longxi Avenue, Liwan District, Guangzhou, Guangdong

information: The limitation is 150 participants, based on a first-come-first-serve rule. For Chinese domestic participants, a completed registration is online registration plus prepaid registration fee. For oversea participants, if you can't pay the fee online, pls contact the delegate or the organizer. Then we will make a reservation for you and you can pay the fee by cash on-the-site.
